lines.text: She walks in like a star!
She entered with main character energy.

data.define: The confident feeling of someone who acts like the hero of their own story.
data.vi: Tự tin như nhân vật chính

example.text: She entered with main character energy.

misuse.text: Don't say 'main character energy' about yourself at work.

hook.text: She walks in like a star!

publish.title: What does "main character energy" mean?
publish.value: Main character energy = Acting like the movie's star. Example: "She entered with main character energy." (very casual English, US).
